entities.summary: Armin Delong was a Czechoslovak physicist. He was the founder of electron microscopy in the former Czechoslovakia. In 1990, he served briefly as a Minister in the Czechoslovak government of Prime Minister Marián Čalfa. At the same time, in 1990, he was elected Vice-Chairman of the Czech Academy of Sciences.
